evidence.explanation: The init_rect diagnostic after alloc cannot execute under the source allocator contract: alloc returns nonnull or panics without returning; MONITOR_HEAP redirects the caller to nhalloc, which also panics before returning null.
evidence.proof: Exact alloc/init_rect/free_rect bodies compiled in normal and MONITOR_HEAP configurations, with exact nhalloc in the latter. A deterministic malloc adapter returns null; a nonreturning panic capture verifies the allocator-level message is reached, never Could not alloc rect. Successful adapter controls exercise init/reinit/free/reinit and match production JS capacity56, count1 and full-map rectangle. global.h declares and documents the nonnull/nonreturning contract and monitor macro redirection.
evidence.control: Both successful-allocation configurations produce malloc call counts1,1,2 across initialization/reuse/reallocation and bounds0,0,79,20; JS reuses storage before free and allocates fresh storage afterward.
